#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int P = 1000000007;

class FastScanner {
    string line;
    istringstream iss;
public:
    int nextInt() {
        getline(cin, line);
        while (line.empty()) getline(cin, line);
        iss.clear();
        iss.str(line);
        int x;
        iss >> x;
        return x;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastScanner fs;
    int n = fs.nextInt();
    vector<vector<long long>> table(n + 1, vector<long long>(n + 1, 0));

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
            if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
            table[i][j] = ((i == 0 ? 0 : table[i - 1][j])
                         + (j == 0 ? 0 : table[i][j - 1])
                         + ((i + j) & 1)) % P;
        }
    }

    cout << table[n][n] << endl;
    return 0;
}
